meta.title: Guest Experience Audit | Independent Quality Control for Short-Term Rentals
meta.description: Independent guest experience audits for Airbnb and Booking.com properties in Greater Porto.

hero.eyebrow: Independent quality control for short-term rentals
hero.title: Know what your next guest will experience.
hero.subtitle: We inspect your property on-site, document what guests will notice and give you a clear action plan before small issues become bad reviews.

one.text: Bedroom Wi-Fi becomes unstable near the bed.

two.text: Kitchen lacks enough forks for four guests.

three.text: Loose bathroom handle tightened during the audit.

problem.title: Everything looks fine—until a guest says otherwise.
problem.subtitle: Most damaging issues are small, physical and easy to miss from a distance.

cleaner.title: The cleaner says everything is fine.
cleaner.text: But cleaning checks do not cover noise, comfort, access, Wi-Fi or wear.

photos.title: The photos look perfect.
photos.text: But photos cannot show smell, weak water pressure or a mattress that guests cannot sleep on.

manager.title: The property manager reports no issues.
manager.text: But the same company is managing and assessing its own work.

review.title: Then the review arrives.
review.text: By that point the guest has already experienced the problem and your rating has absorbed the cost.

alternatives.title: You cannot manage what you cannot truly see.
alternatives.subtitle: Each existing option shows only part of the picture.

cleaner.title: Cleaner
cleaner.text: Checks cleanliness, not the entire guest experience.

manager.title: Property manager
manager.text: Manages the property and evaluates their own performance.

photos.title: Photos
photos.text: Show what is visible, not what is felt, heard or used.

ai.title: AI & software
ai.text: Cannot smell damp, hear appliance noise or test a shower.

self.title: Self-inspection
self.text: Requires your time, physical presence and an objective perspective.

product.title: An independent audit built around the guest journey.
product.subtitle: You receive evidence, priorities and a clear decision path—not a folder of random photos.

inspect.title: See the real experience
inspect.text: We test the property the way a guest actually uses it.

evidence.title: Get clear evidence
evidence.text: Every important finding is supported by photos, videos or measurements.

action.title: Know what to do next
action.text: Each issue is prioritised and paired with a practical recommendation.

methodology.title: We follow the same path your guest does.
methodology.subtitle: The audit is structured around experience, not room-by-room box ticking.

arrival.title: Arrival
arrival.text: Directions, entry, access and first contact.

first.title: First impression
first.text: Smell, temperature, noise, lighting and visible cleanliness.

living.title: Living experience
living.text: Sleep, shower, kitchen, Wi-Fi, work and rest.

hidden.title: Hidden friction
hidden.text: Issues that do not appear in photos but affect a real stay.

owner.title: Owner risks
owner.text: Wear, damage and problems that may become future costs.

report.label: Guest Experience Audit
report.title: A decision tool, not a photo dump.

fixes.title: When a small issue can be fixed safely on the spot, we do it.
fixes.subtitle: Every visit should leave the property better than we found it.

trust.title: Built from real hospitality experience.
trust.text: We do not assess properties because we read about hospitality. We manage a guesthouse ourselves and deal with real guests, real complaints and real operational details every day.
trust.note: Independent. Practical. Focused only on the owner's interests.

area.title: Launching in Greater Porto.
area.text: Porto, Vila do Conde, Póvoa de Varzim, Matosinhos, Maia, Braga, Guimarães, Aveiro and nearby areas, subject to availability.

management.question: Are you a property management company?
management.answer: No. We provide independent quality control and do not manage bookings, guests or daily operations.

cleaning.question: Are you a cleaning company?
cleaning.answer: No. We verify cleaning quality as part of the wider guest experience.

presence.question: Do I need to be present?
presence.answer: No. Access can be coordinated through the owner, cleaner, manager or self check-in system.

duration.question: How long does an audit take?
duration.answer: It depends on the property size and scope. We confirm the expected duration before booking.

repairs.question: Can you fix problems?
repairs.answer: Minor safe fixes can be completed during the visit. Larger work is quoted and scheduled separately.

manager.question: Can you check my property manager's work?
manager.answer: Yes. Independent verification of management quality is one of the main use cases for the service.
